Displayed_Caretaker_Action_Guidance: Emergency pond quarantine: Stop water exchange immediately, engage emergency aerators, notify farm technician.
Critical hypoxia risk: Turn on mechanical paddle-wheel aerators immediately and reduce feed by 50%.
High pH surge: Apply molasses or agricultural organic acid buffer to prevent un-ionized ammonia toxicity.
Acidic runoff detected: Broadcast agricultural lime (calcium carbonate) around pond dikes to buffer alkalinity.
Feed surplus detected: Cut next feeding ration by 25% to prevent uneaten pellet decomposition and benthic hypoxia.
High feeding appetite: Increase next scheduled feed allocation by 10% to sustain optimal growth trajectory.
Thermal stress risk: Increase pond water depth and run aerators to break thermal water stratification.
Salinity dilution warning: Supplement with essential aquatic minerals (magnesium, potassium) to aid shrimp molting.
